content:
Former President Bill Clinton endorsed U.S. Rep. Henry Cuellar's re-election bid, KGNS reported October 28. Cuellar, a Democrat from Laredo, is seeking re-election to the U.S. House in Texas' 28th District.

A Cuellar campaign video circulating with the endorsement shows Clinton backing Cuellar for South Texas families and urging voters to make a plan to vote, according to the campaign's post. The endorsement arrives during the final days of early voting in Webb County, which runs through October 30, ahead of Election Day on November 3.

Webb Watch 956 has covered the District 28 race as part of its election coverage through November 3. Voters can check their registration status and polling places through the Webb County Elections Office.

Sources:

  • KGNS, "Bill Clinton endorses Rep. Henry Cuellar for re-election," October 28, 2026
